title: Contract Violations
concept: When a contract is violated, XIOM traps with a detailed error message showing which contract failed, where, and the values involved.
why: Understanding what happens on violation helps you debug quickly. The trap gives you the exact function, line, and condition that failed.
tips: Read violation messages bottom-up — the 'called from' chain shows the call stack
The values: section shows the state at violation time — invaluable for debugging
Contract violations are deterministic: same inputs always produce the same violation
Use --backtrace flag to get a full stack trace
common_mistakes: Catching contract violations with try/catch — contracts are NOT exceptions, they trap
Assuming contracts are checked in release mode
Ignoring the 'called from' chain — the root cause is often higher up the stack
